newsitem.title: LATVIA: LUKoil plans vehicle oil plant in Latvia.
newsitem.headline: LUKoil plans vehicle oil plant in Latvia.

text.p: Russian oil giant LUKoil plans to build a plant in Latvia to produce vehicle engine oil, LUKoil president Vagit Alikperov was quoted on Wednesday as saying.
The office of Latvian Prime Minister Andris Shkele quoted Alikperov as announcing the plan to build a plant during a meeting with the premier.
No details of the size or cost of the plant were given but Shkele's office said its output would be aimed at the market in all three Baltic states.
The two men also discussed the oil transit business as Latvia is one of the main outlets for Russian crude.
The Ventspils Nafta oil terminal is up for privatisation next year and LUKoil is expected to be one of the bidders for shares in the firm along with Latvian and Western businesses.
Some 30 percent of the firm's shares are expected to be offered to Russian and Western investors and around 40 percent to local companies.
